Pi tool gsd.description: Pi tool schema for status, doctor, run, and resolve-model actions registered by src/extension/register.ts.

Pi command gsd-status.description: Shows pi-gsd status and optional integration detection.

Pi command gsd-doctor.description: Shows pi-gsd diagnostics and integration guidance.

Pi command gsd-run.description: Runs package-local gsd-tools through the thin wrapper.

Pi command gsd-model.description: Resolves and optionally switches Pi model and thinking level for GSD routing targets.

Dynamic GSD Core commands.description: Discovers upstream GSD Core markdown commands and expands prompts for Pi sendUserMessage dispatch.

Pi tool_call guard.description: Registers a Pi tool_call event guard for context-mode tool usage around .planning and small source files.
